kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نأتمن (form VIII)
# نَأْتَمِنُ (naʔtaminu) /naʔ.ta.mi.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
# نَأْتَمِنَ (naʔtamina) /naʔ.ta.mi.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
# نَأْتَمِنْ (naʔtamin) /naʔ.ta.min/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
